nodes.name: Cyril E. King Airport, St Thomas
nodes.note: The airport where Epstein's jets landed for the islands, with US customs pre-clearance on site; from there by helicopter or boat to Little St. James.

nodes.name: US Customs and Border Protection
nodes.note: Six officers, five on St Thomas and one in Palm Beach, were in contact with Epstein between 2012 and 2019, per FBI memos in the DOJ release (The Guardian). The FBI opened a preliminary inquiry in Oct 2019. No officer was charged; the Guardian found no evidence any knew of or took part in the crimes.

nodes.name: Timothy "Bill" Routch
nodes.note: CBP agricultural inspector at the St Thomas airport. In contact with Epstein from late 2012 until he left the territory in 2016; visited Little St. James at least once. Interviewed by the FBI in April 2021; says the contact was business and calls the inquiry a "wild goose chase". Not charged.

nodes.name: James Heil
nodes.note: CBP supervisor on St Thomas. The FBI memos say he expedited Epstein's customs matters and received a holiday food gift. Not charged.

nodes.name: Gerardo Martinez
nodes.note: CBP supervisor in Palm Beach. In regular contact with Epstein in 2018-19, including questions about carrying cash and passport matters (FBI memos, The Guardian). Not charged; the files show no investigation of him.

nodes.name: FBI inquiry into CBP officers (2019-21)
nodes.note: Preliminary investigation opened by FBI New York in October 2019 on a report, disputed, that an officer had befriended Epstein and helped him; Routch interviewed April 2021; credit reports subpoenaed for four officers. No charges; outcome unclear.

nodes.name: Jamie Raskin
nodes.note: Ranking member, House Judiciary Committee. Wrote to Columbia, NYU and other universities on 14 Jan 2026 asking for records of Epstein-linked tuition payments and donations.

nodes.name: Raskin letters to universities (14 Jan 2026)
nodes.note: Letters to Columbia and NYU (among others) setting out survivors' accounts: tuition paid for women, sometimes above cost; admissions promised; Indyke and Kahn arranging tuition and paperwork; Epstein paying visas for MC2 models (Miami Herald). Allegations put to the universities, with requests for records; not findings.

nodes.name: Columbia University
nodes.note: Received Epstein donations 2010-12 (foundation records), including to its dental school. Survivors say Epstein paid for at least two women to attend, around 2002 and 2004-07 (Raskin letter).

nodes.name: New York University
nodes.note: Received Epstein donations 2010-12. Survivors say he promised several women admission and paid some tuition, roughly 1993-2005 (Raskin letter). Allegations, with records requested.

node_notes.n908je: Boeing 727-100, built 1969 (TWA to 1979). Owned by JEGE, Inc. 2001-16 (Business Insider); seats up to 26 (2006 FBI interview with a pilot). Sold in 2017 (The Guardian); stored for a decade at Brunswick Golden Isles Airport, Georgia (AJC, March 2026).
